title: Align strict Boolean projection with Fourfold provenance revision authority

masterplan.active_delivery_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

result.summary: The public strict Boolean compatibility projector now rejects a Forest whose optional provenance source_revision disagrees with the exact Fourfold snapshot revision, matching the canonical compile_relation_blocks trust boundary and the projection verifier's atomic-revision model. This removes one GPU-60 adapter/compiler mismatch without adding a third projection abstraction.
result.structural_change: One existing compatibility path now enforces the same revision-coherence check already enforced by the canonical multi-relation compiler.
result.gardener: No helper, verifier, cache, adapter family, graph authority, fact store, backend, registry, test module, or public API was added. The focused regression was added to the existing strict-projection test owner.

implementation.test_strategy: Construct an exact digest-bound Forest/Fourfold pair whose Forest provenance source_revision differs from the snapshot source_revision and prove the strict Boolean projector refuses it with the same revision-coherence boundary as compile_relation_blocks.
